summary.text: W. Edward Crockett, an unenrolled member, represents House District 112 (Falmouth and Portland, Cumberland County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Portland. The House profile lists membership on the Education and Cultural Affairs and Taxation committees.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives executive as the occupation and lists UMO and Boston College, with a B.A. (1983) and an MBA (1986).
It says Crockett is married, to Martha, with three children and one grandchild.
